knowledge_point.title: Finding a Unit Vector Parallel to a Given Vector

question.:question/problem: The vector $\overrightarrow{AB}$ has magnitude $26$. Which of the following is a unit vector that is parallel to $\overrightarrow{AB}$?
question.:question/worked-solution:
To obtain the unit vector that is parallel to $\overrightarrow{AB}$, we divide $\overrightarrow{AB}$ by its length:

$$
\mathbf{u}=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{AB}}{\mid \,\overrightarrow{AB}\, \mid}=\dfrac{1}{26}\overrightarrow{AB}
$$
